amazon_selection: 20,000 unique ASINs. Prefer titles sharing alphanumeric tokens with the other catalogs, then recognised-title-prefix brand buckets (max 350 per brand), then a deterministic seed-17 reservoir of the original source. Selection is not evidence that any products match.
transforms: Only reported INR prices; absent values remain blank. Description excerpts limited to 2000 characters, Flipkart raw specification excerpts to 4000. No prices invented. Every normalized row retains source licence/link. No shipping data supplied. Myntra per-row dates, MRP and ratings absent. Amazon per-row date, variant and brand fields absent; explicit recognised brand title prefixes recovered.
